title: Reverse Logistics Project Manager
teaser: Seeking a Reverse Logistics Project Manager to oversee the end-to-end product return lifecycle, ensuring process efficiency and financial accuracy. Lead cross-functional collaboration across Customer Support, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Finance. Ideal for candidates with significant experience in reverse logistics and strong organisational skills.
description:
Role Overview

The Reverse Logistics Project Manager leads the end-to-end product return lifecycle, from initial service request to final disposition (credit, scrap, or replacement). This role acts as the primary integrator across Customer Support, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure process efficiency, financial accuracy, and inventory integrity.

Key Responsibilities

1. Service Requests

Review basic information on incoming service requests

Create and maintain function tasks

Assign case owners

Remind CQE (Customer Quality Engineer) about outstanding Engineering tasks

Coordinate with Quality team on cases requiring failure analysis or root-cause investigation

2. Return Requests

Create RMA Order Requests

Maintain RMA# and Tracking# within the Service Request (SR)

Notify Suppliers about returns

Remind CMs to return units within the 60-day window

Serve as primary point of contact for CM logistics and Supplier Buyer coordination on return status

3. Receive Requests

Process inventory transactions (check-in)

Perform physical receiving and quantity verification

Capture Serial/Lot numbers for received units

4. Inspection & Billing Review

Review supplier RMA service charges

Approve billing

Incorporate Quality/Engineering inspection findings into billing and disposition decisions

Work with Supplier Buyers to validate and resolve billing/charge discrepancies

5. Fulfillment Requests

Review aging, stock levels, and business strategy

Capture original pricing information

Check WMS (Warehouse Management System) review status

Determine whether replacement or credit is appropriate

6. Closure & Notification

Notify customers of replacements

Notify customers of credit issuance

Notify Project Managers of hold errors

Oversee SR status with CMs

Notify Engineers of SR cancellations

7. Retention & Scrap

Track and alert on aging timers

Trigger RMA scrap workflows

Update inventory and process financial write-offs

Qualifications

5+ years in reverse logistics, supply chain, or RMA operations

Experience with WMS, inventory management, and RMA/order tracking systems

Strong cross-functional communication skills (Engineering, Quality, Suppliers, CMs, Finance)

Experience coordinating with external partners such as Contract Manufacturers and Supplier Buyers

Detail-oriented with strong organizational and follow-up skills

Oracle, ERP, Power BI

Preferred Skills

Familiarity with billing/credit reconciliation processes

Experience managing aging/timer-based escalation workflows

Ability to manage multiple concurrent RMA cases across different stages

Experience working with Quality/CQE teams on failure analysis or root-cause tracking

Prior experience liaising with CMs or Supplier Buyers on logistics, cost, or contractual matters
